features.sectionDesc: Traditional learning is slow and passive. We flip the script with AI-powered active learning that adapts to you.
features.gapAnalysisDesc: Advanced AI analyzes your goals, experience level, and current knowledge to identify precise learning gaps and create a personalized curriculum tailored to your needs.
features.structuredPathDesc: Stage-Module-Concept hierarchy breaks down complex skills into manageable milestones. Each stage builds on previous knowledge, ensuring systematic and sustainable progress.
features.structureValidateDesc: The AI validator scores your roadmap across multiple dimensions — logic coherence, difficulty curve, and prerequisites — automatically fixing structural issues before you ever see them.
features.humanReviewDesc: You stay in control. Review the AI-generated roadmap, approve it instantly or submit feedback, and the AI will refine it until it perfectly matches your vision.
features.contentGenerationDesc: The AI generates in-depth tutorials, curated resource links, and adaptive quizzes for every concept — a complete, structured learning experience all in one place.

methodologyPage.title: The Fast Learning Method
methodologyPage.subtitle: Master new skills in record time through AI-powered personalization, practice-first learning, and adaptive feedback loops.
methodologyPage.learnByDoing: Learn Faster by Doing, Not Just Watching
methodologyPage.philosophyDesc: Traditional learning is passive and slow. We flip the script with active, project-based learning that gets you building from day one.
methodologyPage.identifyGapsDesc: AI analyzes your goals and current knowledge to pinpoint exactly what you need to learn.
methodologyPage.structuredPathDesc: Stage-Module-Concept hierarchy creates clear, achievable milestones.
methodologyPage.learnByDoingDesc: Every concept ties to practical exercises and real-world projects.
methodologyPage.iterateImproveDesc: Make mistakes, get feedback, correct course. Repeat until mastery.
methodologyPage.twoModesDesc: Choose the mode that fits your learning style, or switch between them as needed.
methodologyPage.companionSubtitle: Learn with AI by your side
methodologyPage.companionDesc: Your AI companion automatically detects what you're studying and provides real-life analogies to demystify complex concepts. Ask anything—it explains in plain language.
methodologyPage.guidedDesc: Your AI guide presents practical challenges and lets you attempt them. Make mistakes—it's part of the process. The guide patiently corrects errors and repeats until mastery.
methodologyPage.multiAgentDesc: Six specialized AI agents collaborate to create and deliver your personalized learning experience.
methodologyPage.intentAnalyzerDesc: Analyzes your learning goals, extracts key technologies, and creates a difficulty profile based on your background.
methodologyPage.curriculumArchitectDesc: Designs a structured roadmap with stages, modules, and concepts. Ensures logical progression and prerequisites.
methodologyPage.tutorialGeneratorDesc: Creates in-depth tutorials with theory, examples, and exercises tailored to your learning preferences.
methodologyPage.resourceRecommenderDesc: Finds and curates the best external resources—articles, videos, courses, and tools—for each topic.
methodologyPage.quizGeneratorDesc: Creates adaptive quizzes with various question types to test understanding and reinforce learning.
methodologyPage.modificationAgentsDesc: Allow you to modify tutorials, resources, and quizzes through natural language conversation.
methodologyPage.journeyDesc: Four simple steps from beginner to expert
methodologyPage.step1Desc: Tell us what you want to learn, your current level, available time, and preferred learning style. Our Intent Analyzer extracts the key insights.
methodologyPage.step2Desc: The Curriculum Architect creates a structured path with clear stages, modules, and concepts. Each element builds on what came before.
methodologyPage.step3Desc: Work through AI-generated tutorials, complete adaptive quizzes, and explore curated resources. Choose Companion or Guided mode based on your needs.
methodologyPage.step4Desc: Chat with AI to modify content, get explanations, or adjust difficulty. Track your progress and celebrate milestones as you achieve mastery.
methodologyPage.startJourney: Start your personalized learning journey today.

pricingPage.title: Simple Pricing
pricingPage.subtitle: Start learning for free. Upgrade when you need more.
pricingPage.faq1Q: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
pricingPage.faq1A: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. You'll continue to have access until the end of your billing period.
pricingPage.faq2Q: What happens to my roadmaps if I downgrade?
pricingPage.faq2A: Your roadmaps are never deleted. On the free plan, you can view all existing roadmaps but can only have one active at a time.
pricingPage.faq3A: Yes! Students with a valid .edu email get 50% off Pro plans. Contact support to apply.

aboutPage.title: About Fast Learning
aboutPage.subtitle: We're building the future of education—where AI doesn't replace teachers, but amplifies learning by creating truly personalized paths to mastery.
aboutPage.visionDesc: A world where anyone can master any skill—quickly, effectively, and affordably.
aboutPage.democratizeDesc: Everyone deserves access to world-class education, regardless of background or location.
aboutPage.personalizedPathsDesc: No two learners are the same. AI creates unique roadmaps tailored to individual needs.
aboutPage.accelerateMasteryDesc: Learn faster by doing, not just watching. Practice-first methodology that works.
aboutPage.story1: Traditional education is broken. It's one-size-fits-all, painfully slow, and disconnected from real-world application. We've all experienced the frustration of sitting through lectures that don't match our level, or tutorials that never quite get to the point.
aboutPage.story2: Fast Learning was born from a simple observation: the best learning happens when you're building something real, when content adapts to your level, and when you have a mentor who understands exactly where you're struggling.
aboutPage.story3: With advances in generative AI, we can finally create that experience at scale. Our multi-agent system doesn't just generate content—it architects personalized learning journeys, adapts to your progress, and guides you through practical projects that cement understanding.
aboutPage.value1Desc: Theory without practice is forgettable. We believe in hands-on learning from day one, where every concept is tied to real application.
aboutPage.value2Desc: The best learners aren't afraid to make mistakes. Our system encourages experimentation and provides gentle correction.
aboutPage.value3Desc: Your learning journey is unique. We adapt everything—content, pace, difficulty—to maximize your growth.
aboutPage.value4Desc: We believe AI should augment human potential, not replace human connection. Our AI explains its reasoning and learns from your feedback.
aboutPage.teamDesc: Fast Learning is built by a small team passionate about education and AI. We're constantly improving based on user feedback.
aboutPage.madeWithPassion: Made with passion for learners everywhere
aboutPage.contactDesc: Have questions, feedback, or just want to say hi? We'd love to hear from you.

newRoadmap.subtitle: Tell us what you want to learn and we'll craft a personalized curriculum.
newRoadmap.completeProfileDesc: A complete profile helps us generate more personalized learning roadmaps
newRoadmap.goalTitle: What do you want to learn?
newRoadmap.goalDesc: Describe your learning goal in detail. The more specific, the better.
newRoadmap.learningGoalPlaceholder: e.g., I want to become a full-stack web developer with React and Node.js

fullstack.label: Full-Stack Development
fullstack.content: I want to become a full-stack web developer proficient in both frontend and backend technologies. I'd like to learn React for building modern user interfaces, Node.js and Express for server-side development, and PostgreSQL for database management. My goal is to build complete web applications from scratch, including authentication, API design, and deployment on cloud platforms.

datascience.label: Data Science & ML
datascience.content: I want to master data science and machine learning to extract insights from data and build predictive models. I'd like to learn Python for data analysis, NumPy and Pandas for data manipulation, scikit-learn for machine learning algorithms, and TensorFlow/PyTorch for deep learning. My goal is to work on real-world datasets and create end-to-end ML pipelines.

mobile.label: Mobile Development
mobile.content: I want to become a mobile app developer capable of building cross-platform applications. I'd like to learn React Native or Flutter to create apps that work on both iOS and Android. My focus includes mobile UI/UX principles, state management, API integration, push notifications, and app store deployment processes.

devops.label: DevOps & Cloud
devops.content: I want to master DevOps practices and cloud infrastructure to streamline software delivery. I'd like to learn Docker and Kubernetes for containerization, CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions or Jenkins, and cloud platforms like AWS or Azure. My goal is to automate deployments, monitor system performance, and implement infrastructure as code.

design.label: UI/UX Design
design.content: I want to become a UI/UX designer who creates beautiful and user-friendly digital experiences. I'd like to learn design principles, Figma for prototyping, user research methods, and design systems. My goal is to master the complete design process from wireframing to high-fidelity mockups and understand how to collaborate effectively with developers.

security.label: Cybersecurity
security.content: I want to specialize in cybersecurity to protect systems and data from threats. I'd like to learn ethical hacking techniques, network security fundamentals, web application security (OWASP Top 10), penetration testing tools, and security best practices. My goal is to identify vulnerabilities and implement robust security measures in software systems.
